title: Academic Departments
body:
Faculty of Arts

The Department of Arts serves as a center for excellence in humanities, offering in-depth study in Political Science, History, Geography, Sociology, and Literature. We focus on developing a deep understanding of social structures and cultural heritage, preparing students for leadership roles in public administration and social research.

Faculty of Science

Our Science Department is dedicated to fostering innovation through rigorous practical training and theoretical mastery. With specialized labs for Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, and Zoology, we provide an environment where students can explore the natural world and prepare for advanced careers in technology and research-driven industries.

Faculty of Commerce

The Department of Commerce bridges the gap between academic theory and the modern business world. Focusing on Accountancy, Business Administration, and Economic Administration (EAFM), the department equips students with the financial acumen and management skills necessary to excel in the global corporate sector.

Department of Computer Science & IT

Focused on the digital future, this department provides cutting-edge training in software development, database management, and information systems. We emphasize hands-on learning to ensure our graduates are proficient in the latest technologies and ready for the fast-paced IT industry.
